developer: Tandem Technology, Inc. Founder & CEO is Sahir Jaggi. Clinical Intelligence led by Adam Harris, MD and Kathleen Alvarez, NP.
availability: Available in the United States; availability abroad not clearly specified.
summary: Tandem is an AI-powered platform that automates end-to-end medication access workflows (prior authorization submission, appeals, pharmacy routing, affordability/patient assistance enrollment, and patient communication).
medicalPurpose: Automate steps of obtaining prior authorization for medications, including PA form generation/submission, appeals, pharmacy navigation, and patient communication.
acceptableInput: Inputs include structured and unstructured clinical/admin data; outputs include structured forms, letters, routing instructions, portal updates, and SMS messages.
output: Completed PA forms, payer follow-up coordination, appeal letters (clinician-approved), enrollment workflows, pharmacy routing, and real-time patient status communications via text; staff dashboards.
roleInDecisionMaking: Provides adjunctive referral support for physicians evaluating suspicious lesions; does not replace clinician judgment, biopsy, or definitive diagnosis.
intendedUsers: Physicians, nurse practitioners, and practice staff at outpatient practices; also used in workflows involving patients waiting to receive medications. No specialized technical knowledge described; requires provider e-prescribing capability.
targetPatientPopulation: U.S. patients requiring medications with prior authorization.
knownFailureModes: Described limitations include scope focused on medication PAs (not all categories), variability in performance for complex cases or non-responsive patients, not a full replacement for PA specialists, and limited public disclosure of model error rates.
requiredClinicianOversight: A prescribing physician (not necessarily a dermatologist) must operate the device and interpret its output. Definitive diagnosis requires clinician judgment and biopsy or pathology confirmation where clinically indicated.
modelType: Workflow automation / administrative support with human review. AI-powered workflow automation platform using a human-in-the-loop approach; combines NLP and machine learning with payer/workflow automation.

performance.summary: HIPAA-compliant; SOC 2 Type II certified; no reported breaches/incidents in cited materials; regulatory context includes CMS interoperability/prior authorization rules. Administrative + human review mitigates clinical risk; security certifications provide assurance of controls.

ongoingMonitoringPlan: Continuous improvement described as platform scales.
